name: Asahina Fuuto
source:
Birth Date: 1995/07/07
Occupation: Idol (actor, singer and dancer) / Third year student in middle school (9th grade).

Fuuto is the 12th son of the Asahina Family. He’s a junior high student, and also a famous idol who often appears in TV shows and commercials. Since he’s balancing work and school, Fuuto has a busy life and can rarely be found at home. Behind his charming idol smile, Fuuto is actually cheeky, sharp-tongued and tends to look down on everyone around him. He holds a deep interest in acting, though he’s also well-known as an exceptionally good dancer.

[from [url=http://koiiro.wordpress.com/2012/06/01/brothers-conflict-passion-pink-fuuto/]Love-Colored Sky[/url]]
